tiles.string2: - "/edithouse" Opens the Map Editor to edit your own house. "/houseentrance" Sets the spawn point of your house when you visit it. "/housesign" Adds a sign on the tile you are standing on. "/housesound" Places a Sound Tile that plays a sound effect on the tile you are standing on.
tiles.string3: "/houselight" Changes the Light/Dark settings of the house. "/houseroof" Opens the roof of the house to set weather conditions and allow the change of time. "/houseweather" Sets the house weather. "/housexpand" Expands the house size.
